claims.quote: Described from the Kapuas River basin in Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan) province, Indonesian Borneo where it occurs alongside the congener A. molobrion.
In recent years very similar-looking fishes have been collected from localities further north, around the border with Sarawak (Malaysian Borneo) including the Kayan and Sambas river basins.
